title: My memories after reading these posts that are the same/ differ from mine...
content: Often driving on long highways either to stop a a friend's house or winding up to tall mountains we have to hike through. Sometimes we make it to a city, sometimes to the mountains. The city looks like a mix going from Long Beach to Vegas, but yet they are connected. On it's South side, the city is also connected to a Mexico type place. The city has a huge central tower with a college on the left and right, and the tower is mostly a parking garage. My old dorm in on the left side. There are hotels and a huge library. The library is calm and I don't remember encountering any issues there. Connected to the library are all sorts of museum type places. An open air aviation museum that if you are at the top of it will scare the shit out of you if you are scared of heights! A book/ music store as well. The parking garage, of course, is connected to the mall. As soon as you go up the initial stairs, there is a toy store on your left. I love this place. I always try to get models of airplanes, Star Wars toys, even one time I almost bought an Opal equivalent to the one in Uncut Gems. The rest of the mall branches out. If you keep going all the way in the direction you came in, you will first pass a pseudo food court with not that many options, but then at the very end the "true" food court. Though the mall is usually chill, problems arise when you cannot stop from sliding around it, find horrible bathrooms, or cannot find your way back to where your car is. Other memory: Some kind of large beach resort type place with lots of kids playground type areas but for adults where you can climb really high, go on boats, jet skis, etc. This is usually connected to the "theme park". As previously mentioned, lots of dreams about theme parks, usually a hybrid in my mind of Disneyland and Six Flags, though they have some other random weird bits. And lastly though I'm sure I'll remember more, I used to camp/ go to a music festival in a spot in Missouri and I have frequent dreams about that spot. I think those are probably more situational to me and the others are FAR more common. I could probably write a book about the mall/ parking garage especially. Oh yea, last one. Big suburban house and you find a tunnel in the basement. No idea where the concrete tunnel goes but it feels very spooky/ haunted. Luckily have not had that dream in years.
